body.x: Knowledge-Seek&Copmany is planning to present Growcheck at CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show), the world largest IT technology held in Las Vegas, USA, from 9th January(Tue) to 12th January (Fri).

Supported by SeongNam Industry Promotion Agency, Knowledge-Seek&Company is able to present its product. Growcheck is a high-tech smart scale and it helps you to measure weight and height easily at home. The measured data is automatically linked to the dedicated app via Bluetooth, and the app provides a growth solution to users by analyzing the data.

In addition, its vertical stand-type design well harmonizes with an interior of house unlike traditional scales; sliding operation system is applied into the design. Growcheck not only measures weight and height by using the laser sensor but also provides solutions if there is any abnormality found in kid’s growth status.

SeongNam Industry Promotion Agency was established in 2001 to contribute to enhancing corporate management and reinforcing competitiveness through comprehensive and systematic supports for small and medium-sized enterprises as well as venture businesses. The agency plays roles in planning & researching for new business development; operating the business center and over-all supports including management/technology/information/foundation/labor force; discovering overseas market and supporting export business; carrying out investment and association of investment for corporate activities.

The world largest IT exhibition, CES, held every January by CTA (Consumer technology Association) is the place where you can feel the world trend in the electronics industry. AVING NEWS is the global news network which broadcasted news the most about the top 3 technology exhibitions: CES(Consumer Technology Show) , MWC(Mobile World Congress),and IFA(International Funkausstellung Berlin) for the past 11 years and this time they will also send dispatch a special press to broadcast issues on global markets and introduce major corporates from Korea.
